title: Theory of Everything
description: Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model as one theory.

puzzle.goal: Write one action for everything known: spacetime curvature with a vacuum energy, the gauge fields with field strength F_μν, matter fermions ψ moving through the gauge-covariant derivative D_μ, and the scalar field φ whose potential has its minimum at |φ| = v. Integrate the sum of all their Lagrangian densities over spacetime with the invariant volume factor built from the metric determinant g.
puzzle.name: Einstein–Hilbert + Standard Model action (core theory)
puzzle.form: int ( sqrt ( - g ) * ( c ^ 4 / ( 16 * π * G ) * ( R - 2 * Λ ) - 1 / 4 * F _ μν * F ^ μν + bar ( ψ ) * ( i * ħ * c * γ ^ μ * D _ μ - m * c ^ 2 ) * ψ + abs ( D _ μ * φ ) ^ 2 - λ * ( abs ( φ ) ^ 2 - v ^ 2 ) ^ 2 ) , x )
puzzle.ask: The couplings in this action run with energy. At one loop 1/α(Q) = 1/α(M) + b/(2π)·ln(Q/M). Starting from the strong coupling α = 0.118 at M = 91.19 GeV with b = @{b}, find 1/α at the unification scale Q = @{Q} GeV.
puzzle.method: Gravity enters as curvature R − 2Λ, gauge fields as −¼F², fermions through the Dirac operator, the scalar through |Dφ|² minus a double-well potential; √−g makes the volume element invariant.
